# Percent chance of ending at rank 2 or better (more than education_level_1 points).
tnt_ga_odds_rank_2_core_value = {
	value = tnt_ga_chance_core_value
	divide = 100
	save_temporary_value_as = tnt_ga_p
	value = 1
	subtract = scope:tnt_ga_p
	save_temporary_value_as = tnt_ga_q
	value = tnt_ga_rolls_left_core_value
	save_temporary_value_as = tnt_ga_n
	value = tnt_ga_projected_points_core_value
	subtract = { value = scope:tnt_ga_p multiply = scope:tnt_ga_n multiply = 2 }
	save_temporary_value_as = tnt_ga_shift
	value = education_level_1
	subtract = scope:tnt_ga_shift
	divide = 2
	floor = yes
	add = 1
	save_temporary_value_as = tnt_ga_kstar
	value = 0
	if = { limit = { scope:tnt_ga_kstar <= 0 scope:tnt_ga_n >= 0 } add = tnt_ga_pmf_0_value }
	if = { limit = { scope:tnt_ga_kstar <= 1 scope:tnt_ga_n >= 1 } add = tnt_ga_pmf_1_value }
	if = { limit = { scope:tnt_ga_kstar <= 2 scope:tnt_ga_n >= 2 } add = tnt_ga_pmf_2_value }
	if = { limit = { scope:tnt_ga_kstar <= 3 scope:tnt_ga_n >= 3 } add = tnt_ga_pmf_3_value }
	if = { limit = { scope:tnt_ga_kstar <= 4 scope:tnt_ga_n >= 4 } add = tnt_ga_pmf_4_value }
	if = { limit = { scope:tnt_ga_kstar <= 5 scope:tnt_ga_n >= 5 } add = tnt_ga_pmf_5_value }
	if = { limit = { scope:tnt_ga_kstar <= 6 scope:tnt_ga_n >= 6 } add = tnt_ga_pmf_6_value }
	if = { limit = { scope:tnt_ga_kstar <= 7 scope:tnt_ga_n >= 7 } add = tnt_ga_pmf_7_value }
	if = { limit = { scope:tnt_ga_kstar <= 8 scope:tnt_ga_n >= 8 } add = tnt_ga_pmf_8_value }
	if = { limit = { scope:tnt_ga_kstar <= 9 scope:tnt_ga_n >= 9 } add = tnt_ga_pmf_9_value }
	if = { limit = { scope:tnt_ga_kstar <= 10 scope:tnt_ga_n >= 10 } add = tnt_ga_pmf_10_value }
	multiply = 100
	max = 100
}

tnt_ga_odds_rank_2_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { tnt_ga_root_is_guardian_trigger_value > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_as = tnt_ga_guardian
		scope:tnt_ga_other = { save_temporary_scope_as = tnt_ga_ward }
		value = tnt_ga_odds_rank_2_core_value
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tnt_ga_root_is_ward_trigger_value > 0 }
		save_temporary_scope_as = tnt_ga_ward
		scope:tnt_ga_other = { save_temporary_scope_as = tnt_ga_guardian }
		value = tnt_ga_odds_rank_2_core_value
	}
}
